enchantments.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Parrying +5: +5 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +5 Insight bonus to Saves.
Doublestrike 12%: Passive: 12% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Guardbreaking: This item enables you to break an enemy's guard in between your melee attacks. On critical hits with your melee weapons, enemies will become dazed as a result.
Insightful Dexterity +5: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +5 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
